rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Cheap large drugmaker with steady cash flow and new drugs coming in to offset Keytruda's patent expiry; it steadies the portfolio.
rows.risks: Revenue gap when Keytruda loses patent protection, and US drug-price pressure.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Leading US steelmaker with a strong balance sheet, helped by import tariffs and infrastructure and data-center construction demand.
rows.risks: Steel prices fall if demand softens.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Pipeline and gas-processing company paid mostly by volume, with Permian volumes growing and payouts to shareholders rising.
rows.risks: Permian drilling slows if oil prices fall.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Leader in cybersecurity software, with recurring revenue speeding up and customers using more of its modules.
rows.risks: High valuation leaves little room for any disappointment.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Refiner returning a lot of cash to shareholders, with refinery use high and a stake in the MPLX pipeline business supporting results.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: Specialty-materials company after its breakup, with better profit margins and electronics exposure that may be undervalued.
rows.risks: Industrial demand weakens or the breakup is poorly executed.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Very cheap generic-drug maker paying down debt and buying back shares.
rows.risks: Generic price erosion and manufacturing-quality problems.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: Efficient refiner that just had a strong quarter; the 10% drop looks like profit-taking, not a broken thesis.
rows.risks: Profit margins fall and refined-product inventories rise.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Data-storage company at a reasonable valuation, helped by demand for all-flash storage and AI data storage.
rows.risks: Companies cut tech spending and the shift to cloud continues.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Results got better (billings +29%, guidance raised) while the stock fell, so the valuation reset makes holding reasonable.
rows.risks: The firewall upgrade wave peaks and growth slows into 2027.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Maker of electronic test equipment, positioned for a recovery in AI and data-center, semiconductor and communications spending.
rows.risks: Orders recover more slowly than expected.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth-management and investment-banking firm, helped by a pickup in deals and strong market activity; financials are leading the market.
rows.risks: Market downturn hits trading and advisory fees.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Leader in gene sequencing at a low valuation, with a margin recovery and possible new product launches as catalysts.
rows.risks: China restrictions and weak research-lab budgets.
